name: Pest Control Live Transfers

hero.headline: Pest Control Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for pest control solutions.

overview: Pest Control Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect homeowners dealing with active infestations or seeking recurring protection with licensed pest control operators in their service area.

Live Transfers ensure that pest control operators receive only calls they can serve. Our team confirms the property address is within the service area, identifies the pest type, verifies that the caller is the homeowner or decision maker and confirms interest in scheduling before warm-transferring the call. This screening is valuable for operators with specialised capabilities, because termite, bed bug and wildlife calls can be routed to teams equipped for them, and out-of-area or renter-only calls are removed before they consume office staff time.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of pest control consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners and property managers who have identified a pest problem and want a professional to resolve it, along with homeowners seeking quarterly or annual prevention plans. Top segments include households with termite or bed bug problems that require specialised treatment, families with children or pets who prefer professional service over DIY, and buyers and sellers needing termite inspections for a home sale.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for exterminators or pest control near me; found evidence of termites, bed bugs, rodents or cockroaches; seasonal surge in ants, mosquitoes, wasps or spiders around the home; real estate transaction requiring a termite or wdo inspection.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "pest control near me" and "exterminator near me", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard pest control criteria include: property located within the operator's active service area; homeowner, property manager or authorised decision maker; type of pest problem identified for correct routing and pricing; residential or commercial property type confirmed; interested in scheduling an inspection or treatment; not an existing customer of the receiving company.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can calls be filtered by pest type?
faq.a: Yes. Screening identifies the pest problem so that operators can accept or exclude categories such as termites, bed bugs, wildlife or general pests based on their services.

faq.q: How precisely can the service area be targeted?
faq.a: Targeting can be set by ZIP code, county or a radius around your branches, and expanded or tightened as your capacity changes.

faq.q: Do programs support recurring service sales?
faq.a: Many callers with general pest problems are receptive to quarterly plans, and messaging can emphasise ongoing protection to attract customers suited to recurring agreements.
